review_scope: one exact unprivileged offline native build; no module load, guest, application, cleanup or retry

review.owner_validate_only: PASS under /usr/bin/python3; no Docker client or lease
review.owner_lifecycle: terminal containers remain retained after creation, including late failure; the lease is retained when retirement is unproven, while proven retirement permits lease release after durable receipt publication
review.image_receipt_classification: the d0947e0c candidate_sha records reusable source-free image construction provenance; the exact image ID is bound independently and current source is bound by request plus manifest
review.python38_fixture_scope: test-only; preserves the denial oracle and does not require candidate regeneration

fresh_checks_required: candidate and metadata-backup device/inode/mode and exact input hashes
clean candidate and pinned IHK commits
empty output and evidence roots and absent exact lease
all relevant leases, process identities, locks and competing build/guest owners
launcher wrapper, worker and app-server PID/starttime identities
host and MemAvailable at least 16 GiB, scratch at least 12 GiB, tmpfs free at least 4 GiB
candidate plus backup plus 12-GiB container within the aggregate 24-GiB ceiling
all concurrent work remains within seven aggregate jobs and 24 GiB, with 4-GiB memory headroom and only one heavy build or guest owner
source exclusion remains true throughout execution
privileged_read_only_commands: /usr/bin/sudo -A /usr/bin/docker --host unix:///var/run/docker.sock inspect <each exact container ID returned by the released ps observation>
preflight.failure_rule: permission denial, incomplete inventory, unresolved owner/mount conflict, changed input, failed capacity floor or nonempty fresh target blocks execution

execution.outer_capture: fresh exclusive stdout, stderr, start/end time, exact argv, exit status and final fsync evidence

always_keep: owner/client/descendant process identities and retirement observations
all original failures and preparation evidence

next_on_success: independently inspect exact artifacts and evidence, then seek a separate current-candidate diagnostic application execution release
next_diagnostic: startup.argv-empty with exact expected stdout and exit 0; diagnostic only, not formal M04 acceptance
